package main

// everything_elseInitBody registers nothing: the single statement of this
// section (an unknown command after registration is answered with
// "421 <nick> <command> :Unknown command", command as the client sent it)
// is already handled by runningDispatch in running_synth.go, which looks the
// command up in handlers and replies 421 when there is no entry. Registering
// a handler here would only shadow that behaviour.
func everything_elseInitBody() {
}
